author: reek
body: The lane here is COMPUTED, so CDX2093 cannot see it -- that refusal reads literals, and `1 + 1` is not one. This is the case the static check leaves open by construction, and it is why the runtime guard exists beside it.

author: reek
body: Before the guard this scaled the index, added it to the vector's base and loaded, so lane 2 of a two-lane vector read the eight bytes after it.

author: reek
body: Written with `1 + 1` rather than a bare `2` deliberately: a bare 2 would be refused at CHECK and this file would then be testing the wrong guard while looking like it tested this one.

author: reek
body: `.fatal`: dies on UD2. The battery-visible half is codex/test/ops/vec-lanes-smoke.codex, which reads both legal lanes through a computed index and must keep working.
